'''Brovto''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="TOR" /> [[Gender/Legends|male]]<ref name="Jedipedia" /> who lived on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. A fair-skinned individual with [[Color/Legends|black]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]] and [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], Brovto usually wore an assortment of medium [[Armor/Legends|armor]] over their clothes and brushed their long hair back. A fluent speaker of [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]], Brovto had a shop in the [[Anchorhead/Legends|Anchorhead]] market where he sold weapon modifications.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Brovto appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], as a Mods Vendor for Republic players on Tatooine.<ref name="TOR" /> With the release of Game Update 4.0 on [[October 20]], [[2015]],<ref name="4.0">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/10202015/game-update-4.0-knights-fallen-empire-early-access|text=Game Update 4.0: Knights of the Fallen Empire Early Access Patch Notes}}</ref> they were removed from the game along with the rest of the Mods Vendors.<ref name="TOR" />
